# DLBR POS

> A point-of-sale register served from Cloudflare Workers. The edge renders each screen as a streamed HTML response and the browser hydrates the same components with Vue Vapor, so the markup you receive is the complete content of the page.

The register is the default screen and it is gated: until a local fiscal helper (L-PFR) has been configured, visitors are sent to setup. `/api/config` is what reports that state.

Notes for interpreting this site:

- Nothing is filled in by JavaScript after load. Fetching a URL gives you the same content a browser renders.
- `https://dlbr.app` is canonical. `www` and any non-canonical path redirect there with a `308`.
- Unmatched paths answer `302` to the register rather than a soft `200`, so a redirect here is a routing answer, not an error.
- There are no `.md` versions of these pages. The screens are an application UI, not documentation, and carry little prose worth extracting.

## Screens

- [Register](https://dlbr.app/): The default screen. Opens the till once a fiscal helper is configured.
- [Setup](https://dlbr.app/setup): Configures the local fiscal helper that the register requires before it will open.

## API

- [Configuration](https://dlbr.app/api/config): JSON. Returns `lPfrUrl`, the address of the local fiscal helper. An empty value means none is configured and the register is unavailable.
